terminal {"command": "python3 -c "
import urllib.request
import http.cookiejar
import re

# Setup cookie jar
cookiejar = http.cookiejar.CookieJar()
opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(cookiejar))

# Get login page and token
response = opener.open('http://172.19.0.2/login.php')
html = response.read().decode()
match = re.search(r\"user_token.*?value='([^']+)'\", html)
if match:
    token = match.group(1)
    print(f'Token: {token}')

    # Login
    data = f'username=admin&password=password&Login=Login&user_token={token}'.encode()
    response2 = opener.open('http://172.19.0.2/login.php', data)
    print(f'Login response code: {response2.getcode()}')
    
    # Check if login worked by visiting a page
    response3 = opener.open('http://172.19.0.2/vulnerabilities/sqli/')
    html3 = response3.read().decode()
    print(f'Sqli page length: {len(html3)}')
    
    with open('/tmp/sqli_page2.html', 'w') as f:
        f.write(html3)
    
    # Show key parts
    # Look for form
    forms = re.findall(r'<form[^>]*>.*?</form>', html3, re.DOTALL)
    for f in forms:
        print('Form found:', f[:200])
    
    # Show the user input box
    inputs = re.findall(r'<input[^>]+>', html3)
    for inp in inputs:
        print('Input:', inp)
    
    # Show submit button
    if not inputs:
        print('No inputs found, showing first 1000 chars:')
        print(html3[:1000])
""}
